sentences.en: We talk a lot about emotions on this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们在播客里经常谈论情绪。

sentences.en: That is basically my bread and butter.
sentences.zh: 那基本上是我的看家本领。

sentences.en: We've spoken about anger and envy and heartbreak, happiness, everything in between.
sentences.zh: 我们聊过愤怒、嫉妒、心碎、快乐，以及介于其间的一切。

sentences.en: But one that we have missed all this time is resentment.
sentences.zh: 但我们一直忽略的一种情绪是怨恨。

sentences.en: And I was kind of thinking about why.
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考为什么。

sentences.en: And the reason I came to is probably because it's kind of an ugly emotion.
sentences.zh: 我得出的结论是，大概因为它是一种比较“丑陋”的情绪。

sentences.en: At least that is what I think society would like to convince us.
sentences.zh: 至少社会想让我们相信是这样的。

sentences.en: Resentment is that deep sense that we have been wronged, that we have been double-crossed, treated unfairly, mistreated.
sentences.zh: 怨恨是一种深层的感觉，觉得我们受到了委屈、被背叛、被不公平对待或被虐待。

sentences.en: And sometimes people confuse that with entitlement and feeling like we deserve more or better than what we have received.
sentences.zh: 有时人们会把它与权利感混淆，觉得我们理应得到比现在更多的东西或更好的待遇。

sentences.en: I tend to disagree.
sentences.zh: 我对此持不同意见。

sentences.en: I think the root of resentment is respect and a sense of fairness.
sentences.zh: 我认为怨恨的根源是尊重和公平感。

sentences.en: And when we feel resentful of somebody, it shows that we respect ourselves enough and we have enough sense of self-worth and self-esteem to know when somebody has crossed a line.
sentences.zh: 当我们对某人感到怨恨时，这表明我们足够尊重自己，并且有足够的自我价值感和自尊心，能意识到别人何时越界了。

sentences.en: We're not always the best at handling that resentment, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们在处理这种怨恨时并不总是很在行。

sentences.en: Even if it does come from a justified place, it can sometimes blind us, blind us with disappointment, blind us with anger or bitterness.
sentences.zh: 即使它源于正当的理由，有时也会蒙蔽我们，让我们被失望、愤怒或苦涩所遮蔽。

sentences.en: It can cause us to lash out or sometimes to end relationships we otherwise would have saved.
sentences.zh: 它可能导致我们爆发，或者有时会结束本可以挽救的关系。

sentences.en: I think it's the behavioral response to resentment that is what we see as ugly.
sentences.zh: 我认为正是对怨恨的行为反应被我们视为丑陋。

sentences.en: But more than that, it's our shame.
sentences.zh: 但不仅如此，还有我们的羞耻感。

sentences.en: It's our shame around how our resentment causes us to act and to behave.
sentences.zh: 我们对自己因怨恨而产生的行为感到羞耻。

sentences.en: So few of us have been really taught how to manage reactions like the ones caused by resentment.
sentences.zh: 我们中很少有人真正被教导过如何管理像怨恨引发的那种反应。

sentences.en: And what can emerge is a pattern of suppression and eventually explosion.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的往往是一种压抑，最终导致爆发的模式。

sentences.en: I've been considering this a lot in my own life recently, especially when it comes down to friendship.
sentences.zh: 最近我在自己的生活中也经常思考这个问题，特别是在友谊方面。

sentences.en: And it's something I know I really have to reach some kind of peace with.
sentences.zh: 我知道我必须与它达成某种和解。

sentences.en: You know, to be vulnerable for a second, I think I've definitely been feeling a bit of resentment around feeling taken advantage of, or like my efforts and some of my friendships
sentences.zh: 你知道，坦诚地说，我觉得自己在某些友谊中确实感到了一些怨恨，因为我觉得自己被利用了，或者觉得我的付出

sentences.en: have been taken for granted recently.
sentences.zh: 最近被视为理所当然。

sentences.en: And it's left me feeling kind of bitter and unacknowledged.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到苦涩和未被认可。

sentences.en: Unacknowledged is probably the best word for it.
sentences.zh: “未被认可”大概是最好的形容词。

sentences.en: And what I've come to realize is that when it comes to resentment, you have three options.
sentences.zh: 我意识到，当谈到怨恨时，你有三种选择。

sentences.en: And only one of them is actually helpful.
sentences.zh: 而其中只有一种是有帮助的。

sentences.en: You can let it control you, which often means fixating on past grievances or trying to justify your emotions, not letting bygones be bygones.
sentences.zh: 你可以让它控制你，这通常意味着纠结于过去的委屈，或者试图为自己的情绪辩解，而不愿让往事随风。

sentences.en: You can let it consume your life and your relationships without ever giving anybody the opportunity to address it or to give you a differing version of reality.
sentences.zh: 你可以让它吞噬你的生活和人际关系，而不给任何人机会去解决它，或者给你一个不同的现实版本。

sentences.en: You could ignore it, which is basically the same as the above.
sentences.zh: 你可以忽视它，这基本上和上面是一样的。

sentences.en: It just delays the inevitable.
sentences.zh: 这只是推迟了不可避免的结果。

sentences.en: It's going to produce the same outcome.
sentences.zh: 它会产生同样的结果。

sentences.en: Your resentment will take control and most likely result in some kind of loss.
sentences.zh: 你的怨恨会占据主导，很可能会导致某种损失。

sentences.en: It's not to say that sometimes that's necessary.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说有时这是不必要的。

sentences.en: Sometimes people have wronged you and your resentment is coming from a healthy place.
sentences.zh: 有时人们确实伤害了你，你的怨恨来自一个健康的出发点。

sentences.en: But the final option, and I think that involves the example I just gave, is sitting with it.
sentences.zh: 但最后一个选择，我认为涉及我刚才给出的例子，那就是与它共处。

sentences.en: Validating your response and why it was only natural to kind of feel that way given the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 认可你的反应，以及为什么在那种情况下产生这种感觉是再自然不过的事。

sentences.en: You can really take away the shame of feeling what others might call entitled or what others might call ugly.
sentences.zh: 你可以真正消除那种因感到别人可能称之为“权利感”或“丑陋”的情绪而产生的羞耻感。

sentences.en: And a step beyond that, you can address it with those around you.
sentences.zh: 更进一步，你可以与周围的人沟通解决它。

sentences.en: I think maturing is realizing that bringing up grievances or slights or problems is actually one of the biggest signs that you truly care about the other person,
sentences.zh: 我认为成熟就是意识到，提出委屈、轻视或问题，实际上是你真正关心对方的最大标志之一，

sentences.en: you care about the relationship, but also you care about yourself enough to endure the awkwardness and the tension of trying to improve things.
sentences.zh: 你关心这段关系，同时也足够关心自己，愿意忍受那种试图改善现状所带来的尴尬和紧张。

sentences.en: You know, it really does show a commitment to wanting to be there or at least a commitment to giving yourself some kind of answer.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这确实表现出一种想要维持关系的承诺，或者至少是给自己一个答案的承诺。

sentences.en: So, I think resentment is such a maze.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为怨恨就像一个迷宫。

sentences.en: It's such a complicated emotion.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常复杂的情绪。

sentences.en: Let's talk about how we can navigate it today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们就来谈谈如何应对它。

sentences.en: I want to speak on its psychological origins, its purpose, you know, even though it's a quote-unquote ugly emotion, we know all emotions have a function, but also its consequences
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈它的心理起源、目的，你知道，尽管它被称为“丑陋”的情绪，但我们知道所有情绪都有其功能，还有它的后果

sentences.en: and its expression.
sentences.zh: 以及它的表达方式。

sentences.en: How we can find a healthy resolution despite our often knee-jerk reaction to lash out in response to resentment.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们经常会有因怨恨而爆发的本能反应，但我们该如何找到健康的解决方法。

sentences.en: Whatever it is that has called you to this episode, whether it is a lack of recognition at your job, an unequal friendship or relationship, an unresolved conflict,
sentences.zh: 无论是什么原因让你收听这一期节目，是因为工作中缺乏认可、不平等的友谊或关系、未解决的冲突，

sentences.zh: 还是破碎的承诺，我希望你能找到一些答案，如果找不到，至少能获得一些清晰的认识和信息。

sentences.en: Resentment has a lot of different sources.
sentences.zh: 怨恨有很多不同的来源。

sentences.en: The biggest one being a sense of
sentences.zh: 最大的来源是某种

sentences.en: unfairness or mistreatment as we spoke of before.
sentences.zh: 不公平感或被虐待的感觉，正如我们之前所说。

sentences.en: Each of us has some kind of perception about how we should be treated and what we deserve from those around us.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人对于自己应该如何被对待，以及从周围人那里应该得到什么，都有某种认知。

sentences.en: It's something that we develop pretty early on by watching how others are treated, experiencing how our parents treat us, what they tell us is right or wrong, how we feel
sentences.zh: 这是我们在很小的时候通过观察别人如何被对待、体验父母如何对待我们、他们告诉我们什么是对是错、以及当我们被糟糕对待时

sentences.en: when we are treated poorly and, of course, our self-esteem and our sense of self-worth.
sentences.zh: 的感受，当然还有我们的自尊和自我价值感，而逐渐形成的。

sentences.en: Things that we commonly believe we deserve are pretty basic.
sentences.zh: 我们普遍认为自己应得的东西其实很基本。

sentences.en: I would say these aren't controversial.
sentences.zh: 我想说这些并不存在争议。

sentences.en: Every single person alive today deserves respect and recognition,
sentences.zh: 当今活着的每一个人都理应得到尊重和认可，

sentences.en: deserves kindness, reciprocity.
sentences.zh: 理应得到善意和互惠。

sentences.en: You know, we want to feel like our emotional, physical, social, mental, all those contributions are matched and we want to feel valued and loved and cared for.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们希望感到自己在情感、身体、社交、心理等方面的贡献能得到对等的回报，我们希望感到被重视、被爱和被关心。

sentences.en: These are often our basics, the bare minimum of what is expected from others as a human being.
sentences.zh: 这些通常是我们的基本需求，是一个人作为人类所能期待的最低限度。

sentences.en: And if you have a healthy sense of self-esteem and sense of self-worth, you don't feel like it's too much to ask for for people to meet these emotional needs or these basics of
sentences.zh: 如果你有健康的自尊和自我价值感，你不会觉得要求人们满足这些情感需求或这些基本的尊重是过分的要求，

sentences.en: respect, knowing that you would treat them the same way.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道你会以同样的方式对待他们。

sentences.en: These are, as I said, the fundamentals, the most basic things.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，这些是基础，是最基本的东西。

sentences.en: Obviously, the more we trust someone, the more we may come to expect from them.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们越信任某人，我们对他们的期望可能就越高。

sentences.en: Yes, you know, your boyfriend or your best friend and a stranger on the street should both show you respect and kindness, but we might expect our best friend to show us things like
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，你的男朋友或最好的朋友，以及街上的陌生人都应该对你表现出尊重和善意，但我们可能会期望最好的朋友表现出

sentences.en: generosity, more reciprocity, more kindness than we would expect from a stranger.
sentences.zh: 慷慨、更多的互惠、更多的善意，这比我们对陌生人的期望要高。

sentences.en: Studies have shown that resentment is most powerful when it is felt towards someone close to us.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，当我们对亲近的人感到怨恨时，这种怨恨最为强烈。

sentences.en: We are less likely to experience as intense amount of resentment towards that stranger than towards someone that we love because our expectations of them and our trust in them
sentences.zh: 我们不太可能对陌生人产生像对我们所爱之人那样强烈的怨恨，因为我们对他们的期望和信任

sentences.en: is more significant, is higher.
sentences.zh: 更为重要，也更高。

sentences.en: Essentially, resentment emerges when our expectations about how we should be treated based on the individual, based on the context and our actions, our expectations are not met
sentences.zh: 本质上，怨恨产生于我们对应该如何被对待的期望——基于个人、背景和我们的行为——没有得到满足时，

sentences.en: and this can be triggered by a number of experiences like being taken advantage of.
sentences.zh: 这可能由多种经历触发，比如被利用。

sentences.en: Maybe you're always paying for everything.
sentences.zh: 也许你总是为一切买单。

sentences.en: You are always giving people gifts, never getting thank yous.
sentences.zh: 你总是送别人礼物，却从没得到过感谢。

sentences.en: You're always putting down gas money and never getting that reciprocated.
sentences.zh: 你总是出油钱，却从未得到过回报。

sentences.en: Another example is being put down or comments or criticisms that you think are unfair.
sentences.zh: 另一个例子是被贬低，或者听到你认为不公平的评论或批评。

sentences.en: You feel like someone is not seeing the situation the way you are or giving you credit.
sentences.zh: 你觉得别人没有像你一样看待情况，或者没有给予你应有的认可。

sentences.en: You maybe resent them for an assumption that they've made about you without full information or the fact that they feel like you don't have enough self-respect and that you would
sentences.zh: 你可能因为他们未掌握全部信息就对你做出的假设而怨恨他们，或者因为他们觉得你没有足够的自尊，认为你竟然

sentences.en: allow them to speak to you that way.
